description: FMP stock news by `symbols` (comma-separated tickers), with `page` and `limit` paging. Needs your own FMP API key (`_apiKey`): Pipeworx does not front one for this pack, and the endpoint is on FMP's paid plans. Items are tagged to the queried symbols but carry no primary-subject flag; for company-keyed news with one, use polygon_io_news.
name: stock_news
title: Stock News
